    The realization functor is fully faithful (Proposition 2.3, Step 2) #

    On intervals this is the full faithfulness of the lift along G together with the full faithfulness of the single functor into the derived category. Morphisms out of L[-1] are computed by (2.4): K(Q)(L[-1], A i) ≅ W / K_i ≅ D_i, K(Q)(L[-1], L[-1]) ≅ k, and all other morphism spaces involving L[-1] vanish for degree reasons or because Q(-, L) = 0 on intervals.

    The resolution functor is fully faithful #
